title: THE BACKWARD DIGEST · The misfold, used
venue: private · after the print tech's misfold of Sept 30, 1999 · Box 23 onward
logline: The last experiment: a page drawn on the actual 1999 misfolded digest from the corkboard, taken down after twenty-eight years, unfolded — the backward page now the right way round — and over its old xerox strip a new drawing in the private washes of the corkboard with a pin hole where the digest hung. The object drawn on the object. Pinned back backward when dry.

panels.composition: An unfolded quarter-letter digest page with a xeroxed 1999 comic strip on it, and drawn over it in muted washes a corkboard with an empty pin hole and a faint rectangle where the same digest hung, a pushpin lying on the drafting table beside the page.
